BiblicalUsage: Sansannah was a town in the south of Judah, named among the cities of the tribe in the allotment of the land. It is one of the many small places that make up the map of the inheritance.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God gives His people real towns in a real land, and Sansannah is one of the names that fills in that map.
